ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious WebDAV LNK Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects possible execution via LNK file accessed on a WebDAV server.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\DavWWWRoot\\\\.*"))
